---
title: "Module 02: Single-cell RNA-seq quality control and filtering"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 02 — Single-cell RNA-seq quality control and filtering
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Examine cell-level QC metrics, evaluate candidate filtering thresholds,
#   apply selected QC thresholds, assess cell retention, and save the
#   QC-filtered Seurat object for downstream analysis.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds
#
# Outputs:
#   data/processed/single_cell/GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#   results/single_cell/qc/
#   figures/single_cell/qc/
#
# Selected filtering thresholds:
#   nFeature_RNA >= 300
#   nFeature_RNA <= 5000
#   percent.mt <= 20
#
# No normalization, dimensionality reduction, clustering, integration,
# or cell-type annotation is performed in this module.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(dplyr)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "qc"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "qc"
)

dir.create(
  results_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  figure_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds"
)

output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 01 output not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}

message("Loading merged single-cell object...")

single_cell <- readRDS(input_file)

DefaultAssay(single_cell) <- "RNA"

message(
  "Loaded: ",
  nrow(single_cell),
  " genes x ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  " cells"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate and inspect QC metrics
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Recalculate mitochondrial transcript percentage using mouse gene names.

mitochondrial_genes <- grep(
  "^mt-",
  rownames(single_cell),
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(mitochondrial_genes) == 0) {
  warning(
    "No mitochondrial genes matched '^mt-'. ",
    "Confirm the gene naming convention."
  )
}

single_cell[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  single_cell,
  pattern = "^mt-"
)


# Confirm that metadata required for QC is available.

required_columns <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mt"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(single_cell@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required metadata: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (
  any(
    is.na(
      single_cell@meta.data[, required_columns]
    )
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Missing values detected in required QC metadata."
  )
}


# Overall QC distributions before filtering.

print(
  summary(
    single_cell@meta.data[
      ,
      c(
        "nCount_RNA",
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
      )
    ]
  )
)


# Sample-level QC summary before filtering.

qc_summary_before <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cells = n(),
    median_counts = median(nCount_RNA),
    median_features = median(nFeature_RNA),
    median_percent_mt = median(percent.mt),
    mean_counts = mean(nCount_RNA),
    mean_features = mean(nFeature_RNA),
    mean_percent_mt = mean(percent.mt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(qc_summary_before)

write.csv(
  qc_summary_before,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "QC_summary_before_filtering.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot QC metrics before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_violin_before <- VlnPlot(
  single_cell,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_RNA",
    "nCount_RNA",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0
)

print(qc_violin_before)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_violin_before_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = qc_violin_before,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


count_feature_before <- FeatureScatter(
  single_cell,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "nFeature_RNA",
  group.by = "sample"
)

print(count_feature_before)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_counts_vs_features_before_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = count_feature_before,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


count_mt_before <- FeatureScatter(
  single_cell,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)

print(count_mt_before)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_counts_vs_mt_before_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = count_mt_before,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


feature_mt_before <- FeatureScatter(
  single_cell,
  feature1 = "nFeature_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)

print(feature_mt_before)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_features_vs_mt_before_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = feature_mt_before,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Evaluate candidate QC thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Summarize the number and percentage of cells that would be removed
# across candidate gene and mitochondrial thresholds.

qc_threshold_summary <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    features_below_300 = sum(nFeature_RNA < 300),
    features_above_5000 = sum(nFeature_RNA > 5000),
    mt_above_10 = sum(percent.mt > 10),
    mt_above_15 = sum(percent.mt > 15),
    mt_above_20 = sum(percent.mt > 20),
    mt_above_25 = sum(percent.mt > 25),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


qc_threshold_percent <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    percent_below_300_features =
      mean(nFeature_RNA < 300) * 100,
    percent_above_5000_features =
      mean(nFeature_RNA > 5000) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_10 =
      mean(percent.mt > 10) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_15 =
      mean(percent.mt > 15) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_20 =
      mean(percent.mt > 20) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_25 =
      mean(percent.mt > 25) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(qc_threshold_summary)
print(qc_threshold_percent)


write.csv(
  qc_threshold_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "QC_candidate_threshold_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  qc_threshold_percent,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "QC_candidate_threshold_percentages.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Apply selected QC thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

min_features <- 300
max_features <- 5000
max_percent_mt <- 20

message(
  "Applying QC thresholds: ",
  min_features,
  " <= nFeature_RNA <= ",
  max_features,
  "; percent.mt <= ",
  max_percent_mt,
  "%"
)


# Estimate cell retention before filtering.

qc_retention_expected <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cells_before = n(),
    cells_retained = sum(
      nFeature_RNA >= min_features &
        nFeature_RNA <= max_features &
        percent.mt <= max_percent_mt
    ),
    cells_removed =
      cells_before - cells_retained,
    percent_retained =
      100 * cells_retained / cells_before,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(qc_retention_expected)


# Apply the selected thresholds.

single_cell_qc <- subset(
  single_cell,
  subset =
    nFeature_RNA >= min_features &
    nFeature_RNA <= max_features &
    percent.mt <= max_percent_mt
)

if (ncol(single_cell_qc) == 0) {
  stop(
    "QC filtering removed all cells."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Summarize filtering results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cells_before <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "cells_before"
  )

cells_after <- single_cell_qc@meta.data %>%
  count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "cells_after"
  )

qc_filter_summary <- cells_before %>%
  left_join(
    cells_after,
    by = c(
      "sample",
      "condition"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cells_after = ifelse(
      is.na(cells_after),
      0,
      cells_after
    ),
    cells_removed =
      cells_before - cells_after,
    percent_retained =
      100 * cells_after / cells_before
  )

print(qc_filter_summary)


# Confirm that all input samples remain after filtering.

expected_samples <- sort(
  unique(single_cell$sample)
)

observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(single_cell_qc$sample)
)

if (!identical(
  expected_samples,
  observed_samples
)) {
  stop(
    "One or more samples were lost during QC filtering. ",
    "Samples retained: ",
    paste(observed_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}


# Confirm that all retained cells satisfy the selected thresholds.

if (
  any(single_cell_qc$nFeature_RNA < min_features) ||
  any(single_cell_qc$nFeature_RNA > max_features) ||
  any(single_cell_qc$percent.mt > max_percent_mt)
) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered object contains cells outside the selected thresholds."
  )
}


# Calculate QC summary after filtering.

print(
  summary(
    single_cell_qc@meta.data[
      ,
      c(
        "nCount_RNA",
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
      )
    ]
  )
)

qc_summary_after <- single_cell_qc@meta.data %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cells = n(),
    median_counts = median(nCount_RNA),
    median_features = median(nFeature_RNA),
    median_percent_mt = median(percent.mt),
    mean_counts = mean(nCount_RNA),
    mean_features = mean(nFeature_RNA),
    mean_percent_mt = mean(percent.mt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(qc_summary_after)


# Save filtering summaries.

write.csv(
  qc_summary_after,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "QC_summary_after_filtering.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  qc_filter_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "QC_filtering_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  qc_retention_expected,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "QC_expected_retention.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot QC metrics after filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_violin_after <- VlnPlot(
  single_cell_qc,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_RNA",
    "nCount_RNA",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0
)

print(qc_violin_after)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_violin_after_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = qc_violin_after,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


count_feature_after <- FeatureScatter(
  single_cell_qc,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "nFeature_RNA",
  group.by = "sample"
)

print(count_feature_after)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_counts_vs_features_after_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = count_feature_after,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


count_mt_after <- FeatureScatter(
  single_cell_qc,
  feature1 = "nCount_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)

print(count_mt_after)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_counts_vs_mt_after_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = count_mt_after,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


feature_mt_after <- FeatureScatter(
  single_cell_qc,
  feature1 = "nFeature_RNA",
  feature2 = "percent.mt",
  group.by = "sample"
)

print(feature_mt_after)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "QC_features_vs_mt_after_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = feature_mt_after,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save QC-filtered object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  single_cell_qc,
  output_file
)

message(
  "Module 02 complete: ",
  ncol(single_cell),
  " cells before QC; ",
  ncol(single_cell_qc),
  " cells retained (",
  round(
    100 * ncol(single_cell_qc) / ncol(single_cell),
    1
  ),
  "%)."
)

message(
  "Saved QC-filtered object: ",
  output_file
)

```
